# dkjson (vendored, single file)

David Kolf's JSON module for Lua 5.1–5.4 — pure Lua, UTF-8 aware,
no external dependencies.

- Version: **2.11** (this directory is NOT a git submodule: upstream has
  no official GitHub repository — the canonical source lives on the
  author's site at <https://dkolf.de/dkjson-lua/>)
- Obtained from the official LuaRocks source package:
  `https://luarocks.org/manifests/dhkolf/dkjson-2.11-1.src.rock`
  (author account `dhkolf`), file `dkjson-2.11.tar.gz` → `dkjson.lua`,
  unmodified.
- License: MIT (see the header of `dkjson.lua`)

To update: download the newest `*.src.rock` from the same location and
replace `dkjson.lua`.
